tool_args.rationale: The dual-horizon candidate is refuted (train RMSE 1.095; confirmation RMSE 0.762). The data show long-horizon sign reversal but do not establish whether it comes from a different horizon law or coupled memory dynamics. The extra fine trajectory batch is the remaining informative probe for distinguishing these mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Refit sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation with different initialization or constraints
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its submitted fit failed both training and fresh confirmation by a wide margin, so numerical refitting alone is unlikely to resolve the mechanism mismatch.

The eight existing rows meet the stated minimum count, but all have identical x_now and mem_conv; an extra fine trajectory can better discriminate trajectory-dependent memory dynamics from a direct horizon law.
The nuisance measurement is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the target law.
